pr.title: fix(release): apply complete Python component semantics to archive comparison
pr.body:
The actual-main rc.16 publisher stopped at the complete Python archive summary comparison on d023a717. The archive owner compared descriptor arrays in raw order instead of applying the existing complete Python component predicate. No tag or release was created.

The archive owner now applies that existing predicate before strictly comparing every remaining summary field. Full descriptor content, duplicate ordering and multiplicity, component positions, original reference validation, raw bytes and every archive/source/service/native/API/publisher gate remain required. Three ordinary metadata units cover permitted reordering, nonmutation and strict rejection of changed contents or outer fields; all prior assertions are retained.

Fresh source5d859a69/tree5501717c reset all three review slots. Its original23 workflow groups and all37 required contexts passed (103checks:97success,6expected skips;166/166 release-validation tests). Complete original Python and JavaScript packets received fresh independent source/result/quality/notes review: [Python review](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/pull/4006#issuecomment-6302356351), [JS/quality/notes review](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/pull/4006#issuecomment-6302617066). No historical approval was transferred.

Current head ff64fc432d641a04521fbe265c658d2dfbe35fd4/tree77ded62b991e8cca28bfd849593153f61ac72d86 is its strict metadata-only child: exactly three null-to-record values in two files. Both independent installation reviews verified all current record hashes and genuine comment bindings, exact inverse restoration of all other profile/notes bytes, all5,183 other leaves/modes unchanged, and unchanged strict admission guards. [Exact receipts and complete evidence](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/tree/d22cade7105a04724ebfa573feac279c606b5afb/docs/release-evidence/ti-compatible-set-20261020/jobs-5d859a6).

The original full S2 suite, exact-head configured review, fresh complete S2 packets and independent lossless/source/reference reconciliation are in progress. Normal qualified merge and all original actual-final-main publication gates remain mandatory. No current S2/main/release qualification or complete d023 raw-report equivalence is claimed.
